_comment: Bundled norm-conserving pseudopotentials. `pseudo/` holds HGH LDA (X.pz-hgh.UPF); `pseudo/pbe/` holds PseudoDojo ONCVPSP PBE (X.pbe-fr-oncvpsp.UPF). z_valence is read from the UPF header at runtime; values listed here are informational. QE lraman supports LDA only, so the PBE set is intended for phonon/IR runs with --no-lraman.
source: LDA: HGH analytical NC pseudopotentials, cpmd2upf v.5.0.1 (pseudo/). PBE: PseudoDojo ONCVPSP-PBE-FR-PDv0.4, fully relativistic NC (pseudo/pbe/).

sources.*.pz-hgh.UPF: HGH LDA NC (cpmd2upf v5.0.1), bundled in pseudo/
sources.*.pbe-fr-oncvpsp.UPF: PseudoDojo ONCVPSP-PBE-FR-PDv0.4 (raw.githubusercontent.com/abinit/pseudo_dojo/master/pseudo_dojo/pseudos/ONCVPSP-PBE-FR-PDv0.4), PBE NC fully relativistic, bundled in pseudo/pbe/
